title: Last Painting by Van Gogh Paired with Postcard
content: Researchers paired an antique postcard with the very last painting made by Vincent Van Gogh before his untimely death. Careful study of the tree roots and rocks clinched it. This was the exact spot he painted from on that fateful day—Rue Daubigny in Auvers-sur-Oise, 20 miles north of Paris.Read more on ArtNet News:How an Old Postcard Led Art Historians to the Spot Where a Distraught Van Gogh Made His Final Painting
